description:
Implement Posner's spatial cueing paradigm in PsychoPy Builder for a cognitive neuroscience study on attentional orienting.

In this classic paradigm, participants fixate on a central cross. A spatial cue (a brief highlight or marker) appears on the left or right side, followed by a target that appears either at the cued location (valid trial) or the opposite location (invalid trial). Some trials have a neutral center cue. Participants press LEFT or RIGHT to indicate the target's location as quickly as possible.

Design specifications:
- Trial sequence: fixation (500ms) → cue (200ms) → brief blank ISI (100ms) → target (until response or 2000ms timeout)
- Cue validity: valid (cue matches target location), invalid (cue opposite target), neutral (center cue)
- Target locations: left or right
- Response keys: 'left' for left target, 'right' for right target

The conditions file must have columns: cue_location, target_location, cue_validity, corrAns
Include all combinations: valid-left, valid-right, invalid-left, invalid-right, neutral-left, neutral-right (at minimum 6 unique conditions).

The experiment must include:
- An instructions routine explaining the task
- A fixation routine (500ms)
- A cue routine (200ms) displaying the spatial cue using the conditions file variables
- A target routine with keyboard response collection
- A trial loop wrapping the fixation-cue-target sequence with the conditions file
- A debrief/end routine

Create the conditions file at:
  /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/conditions/posner_conditions.csv
